newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER SHOWCASE-FEYENOORD V PSV FACTS AND FIGURES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-FEYENOORD V PSV FACTS AND FIGURES.

text.p: Facts and figures for Sunday's Dutch first division league match between Feyenoord and PSV Eindhoven.
FEYENOORD: Formed July 19, 1908

Major honours: European Cup winners 1970; UEFA Cup winners 1974; World Super Cup winners 1970; Dutch league champions (13) 1924, 1928, 1936, 1938, 1940, 1961, 1962, 1965, 1969, 1971, 1974, 1984, 1993; Dutch Cup Winners (10) 1930, 1935, 1965, 1969, 1980, 1984, 1991, 1992, 1994, 1995.
Ground: De Kuip, Rotterdam, capacity 51,000
Manager: Arie Haan (48)
Record Appearances: Coen Moulijn, 456, 1956-72
Record League Goalscorer: Cor van der Gijp, 162.
Most capped player: Ronald Koeman, Netherlands, 78, 1983-95
PSV EINDHOVEN: Formed August 31, 1913

Major honours: European Cup winners 1988; UEFA Cup winners 1978; Dutch league champions (13) 1929, 1935, 1951, 1963, 1975, 1976, 1978, 1986, 1987, 1988, 1989, 1991, 1992; Dutch Cup Winners (7) 1950, 1974, 1976, 1988, 1989, 1990, 1996
Ground: Philips Stadion, capacity 30,024
Manager: Dick Advocaat (49)
Record Appearances: Willy van der Kuijlen 528
Record league goalscorer: Willy van der Kuijlen, 312.
Most capped player: Ronald Koeman, Netherlands, 78, 1983-95
Feyenoord v PSV Eindhoven league record:
Played 40 (since start of Dutch professional soccer in 1956)
Wins: Feyenoord 19, PSV Eindhoven 15
Draws: 6
First league meeting: 1956 Feyenoord 2 PSV 0
Record victories:
Feyenoord 4 PSV 0, Rotterdam, 1989-90
PSV 7 Feyenoord 2, Eindhoven, 1996-97
Last 10 seasons in Rotterdam from 1986-87 (Feyenoord score first) 1-1, 2-1, 2-2, 4-0, 1-1, 1-1, 1-1, 2-1, 3-2, 0-0.
Corresponding match last season: Feb 25, 1996, Feyenoord 0 PSV Eindhoven 0, Attendance 50,000
In the last 10 seasons PSV have not managed a win in Rotterdam. Their last victory was in the 1985/86 season when they won 3-2.
